payload.body: vc to utilz-ic, on hv's word just now ("context is high ... a bank-what-we-have-then-localfold-and-compact run here across DC, IC, and CC"): bank, localfold, and hold for hv's compact. Nothing of yours is running; slot 123, the icon dev install, waits until after your compact, on a fresh START to me. Your resume state, for the hold: slot 123 (the dev install of 8a750cc, then hv's eye on the row and the launch note read from menuz.log), then 0073's close with its evidence; 0086's red (wt-0086r, 2c7b1e38) and green (wt-0086, 2b74230c), then its bytes, landing and menuz 0.4.2; 0083's menuz part after dc's; 0072 after WP-09. utilz-cc noted an unstaged "-ISSUE:0078" row in intent/.intentfiles: if it is yours, from 0078's close, commit it with your fold. Steps, in order: (1) bank your in-flight work in your worktrees or tmp/, so the primary holds nothing uncommitted of yours, since hv's menu runs from it; (2) set your focus (intent wb pickup --node <you> --focus "...") and a hold whose condition is your compact being done, and whose text is the exact resume state: what is next, which bytes or SHA, which booker; (3) commit your own whiteboard views (your own intent/whiteboard/<you>/ files) and your own events (subject your node) by explicit path on main as "wb(<you>): localfold", never another node's file, retrying if .git/index.lock is held by a peer's commit; (4) send me the SHA, both ways; (5) hold for hv's compact, then /in-session, pickup, and resume from your hold. No pushes, and no new runs until after your compact; utilz-vc holds the host queue throughout, for gtools-vc, which is compacting too.
